title: Orthonormal coordinates adapted to the rotated plane q0(R^n x {0})
statement:
For all natural numbers n, l:
(i) graphPoint a b = E^{-1}(a, b) for all a in R^n and b in R^l. Here E = EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd : R^{n+l} -> R^n x R^l is Mathlib's canonical continuous linear splitting into the first n and the last l coordinates.
(ii) |graphPoint a b|^2 = |a|^2 + |b|^2.
(iii) For every linear isometry q0 of R^{n+l} and all a, b, the distance infDist from q0(graphPoint a b) to the n-plane rotatedPlane q0 = q0(R^n x {0}) equals |b|.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), graphPoint a b = (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd : Amb n ℓ ≃L[ℝ] Rn n × Rn ℓ).symm (a, b)) ∧ (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), ‖graphPoint a b‖ ^ 2 = ‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2) ∧ ∀ (q₀ : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), infDist (q₀ (graphPoint a b)) (rotatedPlane q₀ : Set (Amb n ℓ)) = ‖b‖
